height_class.description: Body proportions: short (dwarf-like), average (human), tall (elf-like). Also selects the matching Aseprite rig geometry.

view.description: Camera framing, e.g. 'side view, facing right, full body, centered'. Canvas size is fixed at 32x32 to match the game and is not configurable here.

head.description: Face, helmet, headwear (excluding hair/beard, see hairstyle/has_beard)

hairstyle.description: Hair description, e.g. 'short cropped hair' or 'bald'

has_beard.description: Whether the character has a beard

has_helmet.description: Whether the character wears a helmet

left_hand.description: What the character holds in their own left hand, or 'empty'

right_hand.description: What the character holds in their own right hand, or 'empty'

positive_prompt.description: Freeform extra notes appended after the structured fields

character_lora.description: Optional trained SD 1.5 character LoRA filename installed in ComfyUI/models/loras
